limitations: Original matching includes bConfigurationValue, bInterfaceNumber and sometimes bcdDevice; reducing this to VID:PID broadens matches.

Exact numeric correspondence in a Linux table does not establish native Tahoe support, physical-unit verification, interface compatibility, license compatibility or a complete implementation.
Linux USB table cross-check is restricted to the pinned files recorded here; absence is not proof that no other open-source implementation exists.
